smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.public_impact: No new public API or cache admission/observer policy. One internal generic typed map utility may service both committed and pending maps, with stable prepared slots and identity-based unlink. New utility must be added to Root owner/source read freeze before authored changes.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.keys: Store original typed key plus exact cached int hash; do not Math.Abs(int.MinValue). Ordinary equality/hash semantics remain stable collection prerequisite. Hash/equality can throw persistently on lookup/preparation; lookup is allowed to fail without ownership corruption.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.prepare: Resolve bucket by builtin-int hash, perform user Equals/GetHashCode and uniqueness/pending checks before ANY logical publication. Preallocate candidate entry, per-index slots, absent buckets and needed backing structural capacity. Validate indexVersion and pending-invalidated/owner availability after final user callback before publish.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.publish: One owner-lock phase links only builtin-int bucket slots, entry handle metadata, long-id master entry and exact original pending bookkeeping. No selector, comparer, notification, usage accessor, disposal or awaiting after logical publish begins. Direct caller ownership transfers only at complete publication; factory prepublication rejection releases produced candidate1.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.identity_remove: Each linked slot carries owner/bucket and stable identity. Entry/pending handle removal must be idempotent and only unlink exact same live slot, never key-based search. Correctly maintain previous/next/head/tail and map cardinality; clear payload/key/link references and remove empty builtin-int bucket. A removed old handle must not unlink a new equal-key slot.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.pending: Admission adds prepared pending slot and _pendingCreations object as one stable phase, after linked CTS allocation and metadata preparation. Clear detaches pending map reservation but retains old factory capacity until actual rejected value release and OwnershipReleased. Late old factory cleanup removes old slot by identity/no-op if already detached; must not remove replacement pending. Signal public Completion and OwnershipReleased exactly once with existing required result/cancel/fault policy.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.capacity: Preserve Count(committed)+PendingCreations+retiring <= Capacity in owned-resource admission; public Statistics omits retiring, so blocked disposal/capacity-gate probes supplement it. No empty prepared bucket can be published when later index prepare fails. Bound backing growth to owned slots/buckets, never append retained failed/dead tombstones. User-configured number of indexes remains unbounded as before; no byte/RSS promise.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.cost: Ordinary lookup/preparation visits only hashed collision bucket; expected local O(bucket chain + index count). Adversarial constant-hash worst-case O(C) remains possible. No clone of every existing dictionary per operation and no O(C*I) allocation per mutation. Existing expiration scan may remain O(C), and full Clear/Dispose necessarily visit retained entries. Extra handles/buckets are per retained resource/index/pending, not per historical failed attempt.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.bulk_index: AddIndex builds entirely unpublished map/handles, completes all selector and comparer work then validates original snapshot before publishing both index reference and existing-entry metadata. Failed AddIndex must not leave metadata pointing to hidden index, because later Remove would otherwise consult it.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.retirement: Remove/CleanupExpired/eviction/Clear/Dispose unlink stored handles without user callbacks, update main/Active/retiring/version coherently, hand actual owned release list to outside-lock cleanup even if a later required lookup/preparation/clock throws. Keep serialized awaited observer dispatch and cancellation ownership unchanged.
smallest_prepared_stable_hash_map_contra.boundaries: No universal OOM/fatal-error transaction guarantee, no malicious changing equality/hash semantics, no arbitrary comparer reentrant mutation contract, no full RAM proof. Structural no-dead-slot proof must accompany native public churn/admission controls; public Count/Pending alone cannot prove hidden bucket/key retention absent.

Release only old factory and join Clear/old candidate disposal while replacement remains pending. Public GetAsync and another GetOrAdd must attach to replacement, third factory calls0. Finally release replacement and join all request/clear/dispose tasks with exact releases and pending0. One additional proposed native case, using actual public gates and no reflection; existing new-generation test completes replacement earlier and is insufficient for this specific live-pending branch.
